reason: My buyers already find me on WhatsApp and my Facebook lives, and broadcasts cost me nothing. I've never needed SMS, so even at 560 rupees I don't see why I'd pay for something my customers would probably ignore.
objection: My customers reply and order on WhatsApp, not by SMS. An SMS from a shop name feels like a bank or spam message, and I don't know if it would bring even one extra order.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another Instagram or Facebook seller like me get real extra orders from an SMS blast during a sale, for example when WhatsApp broadcasts stop reaching people.
